observations: Photo 0: Interior of a chest freezer with a white wire basket on the right side. The interior walls are dirty and have frost or ice buildup. A plastic water bottle labeled 'FRETA' is placed in the basket. The lid has a textured pattern with circular indentations and a white handle with a blue and white wire attached.

Photo 1: Top and front view of the freezer. The top surface is heavily stained with brown and black discoloration, possibly mold or dirt. The front has a white handle and a small label on the right side. A sticker with a blue and green design is on the lower left front.

Photo 2: Side and back view of the freezer. The back panel is exposed, showing the condenser coils and a power cord plugged into a wall socket. The side panel is dirty and shows signs of wear. A yellowish switch or thermostat is visible on the side. The freezer is placed on a marble-patterned floor.

The freezer appears to be an older model with significant surface dirt and interior frost. The brand and model are not visible in any photo. The seller claims it is a 'Fast freezing nexus freezer', but no such branding is visible.

claims.evidence: No brand or model name is visible in any photo. The seller's text alone cannot confirm the brand or model.

risks.risk: The freezer may not be in working condition or may have poor cooling performance due to visible frost buildup and dirt.
risks.proof: A video showing the freezer running with the door closed, and a temperature reading inside after 24 hours.

risks.risk: The interior and exterior dirt and mold may indicate long-term neglect, which could affect hygiene and functionality.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the interior and exterior surfaces, especially the stains and frost, and a video of the freezer being cleaned or showing the condition after cleaning.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used and dirty

risks.risk: The exposed back panel and visible condenser coils may indicate damage or improper maintenance, which could affect cooling efficiency.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the condenser coils and the compressor area, showing no damage or blockage.

proof_requests: A clear photo or video showing the brand and model name on the freezer, if any.
A video showing the freezer running with the door closed, and a temperature reading inside after 24 hours.
Close-up photos of the interior and exterior surfaces, especially the stains and frost.
A close-up photo of the condenser coils and the compressor area.
response.reason: The brand and model of the freezer cannot be identified from the photos, and the seller's claim is unverified.
